page.overview:
Who is Snow Devil?

The の|Yuki no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of snow.

The Snow Devil's body is puffy and white resembling clumps of snow. It has a pair of horns and bulbous eyes.

The Snow Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point after breaking free from Public Safety's trap, Pochita proceeds to erase more Devils by consuming them as he continues to rampage through the city, including the Snow Devil. During their time trapped in the Aging's World, Asa tells Denji that he taught her to have something to live for despite not getting over the death of her mother. Denji then pukes out the head of the Snow Devil, which restores the concept of snow. Seeing snow again causes Denji to remember his winter boat ride to Hokkaido with Aki and Power.
